## Required outputs

|---|---|---|---|
| round-pack | `assets/call-for-action-and-status.md`: agenda, plant status table, numbered call for action | OD lead (approves, sends) | Every status cell cites its source list and read date; One traffic light per round; OD lead has approved escalation wording and deadline |
| follow-up-log | Section 4 of the round pack | `dept-decision-rights`, `dept-retro`, Owners named in | Q&A classified and routed to the owning service line; Open homework chased; Unresolved items carried with the label "carried" |

| routed-demand | The request sorted as small change, project or governance board | `dept-decision-rights`, OpenSpec IT demand (external) | Sorted with `dept-intake` first, then by the routing reference; Owner named |

## Handoff

- **Receives from:** `metrics-scorecard`, `dept-risk`, `dept-decision-rights`, `funnel-use-case`
- **Next:** the OD lead for packs; the owner named in dept-decision-rights for routed requests; dept-retro for round feedback; dept-risk for indicator gaps; know-training for the training programme.: `dept-decision-rights`, `dept-retro`, `dept-risk`, `know-training`
- **Stops here when:** a sprint lacks an expert for the process, a defined baseline or agreed architecture and access
- **Stops here when:** the machine is not connected (a wave first)
- **Stops here when:** or an escalation, route, budget or priority would be decided by the agent
- **Stops here when:** Recorded demand is not proven saving
- **Stops here when:** ODEC is not a current forum
